notes.title: Epilogue achievement bug fixed
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41551795/21fbf775758b845a29b317112417d165828fd760.png[/img]

Hello,

It’s been a while since I’ve given you news.

Some fans have reported bugs related to the epilogue achievements. (Thank you so much.)
It was revised and updated on June 27, 2024.
Please run the update and check.

The game studio 'Blue Moon' that developed Boys Tale was disbanded.
As the person in charge of operations, I am working hard to ensure that you can enjoy Boys Tale.

If you find another bug, please report it.

Thank you very much.

notes.title: Hello. We deliver Boys Tale news!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41551795/269b994d9a1160c5251e6f0f97dfc95d04045349.png[/img]


1. In the April update, the ability to turn off scenario auto-reading mode has been added.
This revision was made based on suggestions from fans.
If there is anything else that interferes with enjoying Boys Tale, please let me know.

2. We are preparing a new character. Who is that silhouette on the banner?

Thank you to everyone who loves Sia's adventures.

notes.title: The novel 'Boys Tale' has been published in Korea!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41551795/6dda9b37449d1cd2a1c9adb34d84b2f4ae029383.png[/img]


We deliver news to Boys Tale fans!

The novel 'Boys Tale' has been published in Korea!

The novel also includes a side story that was not seen in the game.

If you would like to read the novel, please click the link below.
(You need to register as a member on the Ridibooks site to use it.)

https://ridibooks.com/books/4770000001?_s=search&_q=%EB%B3%B4%EC%9D%B4%EC%A6%88%ED%85%8C%EC%9D%BC&_rdt_sid=search&_rdt_idx=0

In the future, we will create more diverse content to entertain you.

Thank you.

notes.title: English version text improvement

notes.title: News: Boys Tale price change news
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41551795/eb32fd20168cb767689ad9c1eb2c619d00d43334.png[/img]

Hello, This is Blue Moon.

After launching Boys Tale, many BL fans from all over the world supported us.
By the way, many of them made a wish to lower the price of the game...
We have decided to make that wish come true!

[b]Significantly lowered the Boys Tale price! $2.99~!!!!![/b]

Now more people will be able to enjoy Sia's adventures!


* For those who purchased before the price change, please inform me of your Steam ID to the email below by February 20, 2022.
(teamsnowball.cs@gmail.com)
I will send you an art book and OST that will be released later for free.

Thank you so much for your love and support.

notes.title: [Dev.note 001] Hello. This is Blue Moon.
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41551795/ec8d4966449982639ff06ac73e8851a783a18206.png[/img]

Hello. This is Blue Moon, who developed Boys Tale.

First of all, thank you to the all users who purchased Boys Tale.

Blue Moon is an indie game team with the motto 'Let's make the game we want to play!'
We want to make only BL games forever. (LOL)

We hope that Boys Tale will be loved for a long time, and we will tell you about the update news.

1) English version problem
We are improving the English translation little by little through volunteers and experts.
If you have any noticeable issues with the English version, please let me know!
We will correct it right away.

2) Add character
The following characters will be revealed in March. Can't wait to see what kind of character will come out! >.<

3) Web novel publishing
Boys Tale web novel will be published in South Korea!!!
We will notify you again when the publication date is decided.


Even if you criticize us for not being professional enough to release a game like this... we have nothing to say.
But we'll keep updating the game to make sure the money you pay is well worth it!

Please continue to love Boys Tale a lot in the future.

Thank you very much.
